title: 🚨 The Senate Is Now a 50-50 Coin Flip | Chris Cillizza
description:
For free and unbiased Medicare help, dial to 337-CHAPTER (337-242-7837) to speak with my trusted partner, Chapter, or go to https://askchapter.org/chris

📊 The battle for the U.S. Senate is officially a coin flip.

- 🎯 50-50 race: Decision Desk HQ now gives Democrats and Republicans an equal chance of controlling the Senate after the midterms.

- ⚖️ The two likeliest outcomes are tied: Either Republicans hold a 50-50 Senate with Vice President JD Vance breaking ties — or Democrats win a 51-49 majority.

- 📉 A major shift: Republicans held a clearer advantage through much of the summer, but that edge has evaporated.

- 🔥 The map is expanding: Alaska, Iowa, and Texas — all states Donald Trump won by double digits in 2024 — have moved into toss-up territory.

- 👀 Prediction markets agree: Polymarket gives Democrats a slight edge, while Kalshi gives Republicans a narrow advantage. Translation: it’s incredibly close.

- ⏰ Only 56 days remain: Democrats are still underdogs on this Senate map, but they’ve kept the fight competitive into the fourth quarter.

- 🏀 The bottom line: Control of the Senate is now a jump ball — and either party could win it.
